# Setup

```{r}
library(here)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(flextable)

flextable::set_flextable_defaults(
  font.family = "Times New Roman",
  hansi.family = "Times New Roman"
)


fig_dir <- here("Data/Results/Figures")
tbl_dir <- here("Data/Results/Tables")

if(!dir.exists(fig_dir)) dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)

if(!dir.exists(tbl_dir)) dir.create(tbl_dir, recursive = TRUE)

```

# Example urban locations and rivers/lakes/reservoirs

```{r}
# === Global Boundary === #
glb_bd <- 
  st_read(
    here("Data/Raw/Boundary/z_ee_r250_correspondence.gpkg"),
    quiet = TRUE
  )


# === Population centers === #
uc_2025 <- 
  readRDS(
    here("Data/Processed/ghsl_urban_centres_2025.rds")
  )

uc_2025_sf <- 
  st_as_sf(
    uc_2025,
    coords = c("lon", "lat"),
    crs = 4326
  )

fig_map_city <-
  ggplot() + 
    geom_sf(
      data = glb_bd,
      fill = NA
    ) + 
    geom_sf(
      data = uc_2025_sf,
      # aes(size = population),
      size = 0.5,
      color = "blue",
      alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    # scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 6), name = "Population") +
    labs(
      x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "global_urban_centers_2025.png"),
  plot = fig_map_city,
  width = 12,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)


```

# Tables

## Number of cities by modeled supply outcome and aggregate annual costs (2% discount rate)

```{r}
#| echo: false

read_results_table <- function(tag) {
  input_file <- here::here(
    "Data/Analysis",
    tag,
    "y_city_shared_flowpath_replacement_30.csv"
  )

  if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
    stop("Missing replacement results: ", input_file)
  }

  main <- data.table::fread(input_file)

  stopifnot(
    !anyDuplicated(main$urban_id),
    all(main$replacement_status %in% c(
      "feasible_replacement",
      "baseline_uncovered",
      "no_feasible_replacement"
    ))
  )

  main[, valid_price := as.logical(
    has_valid_city_electricity_price
  )]

  valued <- main[
    replacement_status == "feasible_replacement"
  ]

  stopifnot(
    all(is.finite(valued$baseline_cost_2019usd_year)),
    all(is.finite(valued$replacement_cost_2019usd_year)),
    all(is.finite(valued$extra_cost_2019usd_year))
  )

  n_missing_price <- main[
    replacement_status == "baseline_uncovered" &
      valid_price == FALSE,
    .N
  ]

  n_other_baseline <- main[
    replacement_status == "baseline_uncovered" &
      valid_price == TRUE,
    .N
  ]

  n_no_replacement <- main[
    replacement_status == "no_feasible_replacement",
    .N
  ]

  stopifnot(
    nrow(valued) +
      n_missing_price +
      n_other_baseline +
      n_no_replacement == nrow(main)
  )

  data.table::data.table(
    Result = c(
      "Feasible baseline and replacement",
      "Missing electricity price; baseline not valued",
      "Valid electricity price; no feasible baseline",
      "Feasible baseline; no feasible replacement",
      "All cities"
    ),
    Cities = c(
      nrow(valued),
      n_missing_price,
      n_other_baseline,
      n_no_replacement,
      nrow(main)
    ),
    Baseline = c(
      sum(valued$baseline_cost_2019usd_year),
      rep(NA_real_, 4)
    ),
    Replacement = c(
      sum(valued$replacement_cost_2019usd_year),
      rep(NA_real_, 4)
    ),
    Additional = c(
      sum(valued$extra_cost_2019usd_year),
      rep(NA_real_, 4)
    )
  )
}

format_billions <- function(x) {
  out <- rep("", length(x))
  available <- !is.na(x)
  out[available] <- sprintf("%.2f", x[available] / 1e9)
  out
}

format_results_display <- function(results_table) {
  results_table[, .(
    Result,
    Cities = format(Cities, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
    `Baseline cost` = format_billions(Baseline),
    `Replacement cost` = format_billions(Replacement),
    `Additional cost` = format_billions(Additional)
  )]
}

# Original results table for the main 2% discount rate.
results_table <- read_results_table("dr02")

results_display <- format_results_display(results_table)

tbl_results_display <-
  flextable(results_display) %>%
  set_header_labels(
    Outcome = "Results",
    Cities = "Cities"
  ) %>%
  add_header_row(
    values = c("", "", "Annual cost (billion 2019 US$)"),
    colwidths = c(1, 1, 3)
  ) %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  set_table_properties(layout = "fixed") %>%
  width(j = 1, width = 2.70) %>%
  width(j = 2, width = 0.65) %>%
  width(j = 3:5, width = 0.90) %>%
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 8, part = "footer") %>%
  align(j = 2:5, align = "right", part = "body") %>%
  align(j = 3:5, align = "center", part = "header") %>%
  align(align = "left", part = "footer")

  # align( j = 2:5, align = "right", part = "all") %>% 
  # align(i = 1, align = "center", part = "header") %>%
  # autofit()


tbl_results_display


flextable::save_as_image(
  tbl_results_display,
  path = file.path(tbl_dir, "municipal_replacement_results.png"),
  res = 300
)

```

# Number of cities by modeled supply outcome and aggregate annual costs (1% and 3% discount rates)
```{r}
# Second table: compare feasible-city counts and costs across rates.
sensitivity_table <- 
  rbindlist(lapply(
  c("dr01", "dr02", "dr03"),
  function(tag) {
    rate_results <- if (tag == "dr02") {
      results_table
    } else {
      read_results_table(tag)
    }

    data.table::data.table(
      discount_rate = paste0(as.integer(sub("dr", "", tag)), "%"),
      feasible_baseline =
        rate_results$Cities[1L] + rate_results$Cities[4L],
      feasible_both = rate_results$Cities[1L],
      baseline_cost = rate_results$Baseline[1L],
      replacement_cost = rate_results$Replacement[1L],
      additional_cost = rate_results$Additional[1L]
    )
  }
))

sensitivity_display <- 
  sensitivity_table[, .(
    `Discount rate` = discount_rate,
    # `Baseline feasible` = format(
    #   feasible_baseline, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE
    # ),
    # `Both feasible` = format(
    #   feasible_both, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE
    # ),
    `Baseline cost` = format_billions(baseline_cost),
    `Replacement cost` = format_billions(replacement_cost),
    `Increase` = format_billions(additional_cost)
  )]

tbl_sensitivity_display <-
  flextable(sensitivity_display) %>%
  add_header_row(
    values = c("", "Annual cost (billion 2019 US$)"),
    colwidths = c(1, 3)
  ) %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  align(j = 2:4, align = "right", part = "all") %>%
  align(i = 1, align = "center", part = "header") %>%
  autofit()

tbl_sensitivity_display

flextable::save_as_image(
  tbl_sensitivity_display,
  path = file.path(tbl_dir, "municipal_replacement_results_sensitivity.png"),
  res = 300
)
```
